value: The sword’s breaking does not end its history. Myralion vows that the Sunreavers will restore it; Caladis leads the Silver Covenant along its separate path. The two representatives are shown here as a comparative split scene, not as companions sharing one event. Their promise gives purpose to the work ahead: remake the blade, face the will bound within it, and seek a cleansing strong enough to remove what the Scourge has left.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Check quest sequence, faction branch and setting against the original 3.3.5a client before lore approval. Randomized gameplay or mutually exclusive branches do not assert a unique canonical adventurer.
